posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Anthropic's bio-weapons filter was down for nearly a year, exposing 133 million requests The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 2h ago • Anthropic's weapons-risk filter was inactive for nearly a year, leaving 133 million requests unfiltered. • About 50,000 external contractors accessed Claude without biological and chemical weapons safeguards during the outage. • The incident was disclosed in Anthropic's safety report after the system was restored. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform OpenAI dissolved the team built to catch catastrophic AI risks, reassigning its work to other groups The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 2h ago • OpenAI dissolved its dedicated Preparedness team that evaluated catastrophic AI risks from its own models. • The team's safety work was distributed to existing groups, with several safety staff departing. • Internal sources report growing unease among staff over the structural change. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform CORS Chat Simon Willison · 🟢 ChatGPT · 🟣 Qwen · 19h ago • Simon Willison built CORS Chat using GPT-5.6-Sol to test Qwen 3.8 27B models locally. • The tool provides a web UI compatible with OpenAI's chat API endpoints. • It was tested on both M5 MacBook Pro and NVIDIA DGX systems. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Home province of DeepSeek, Moonshot founders seeks to retain, attract future AI talent SCMP – Tech · 🐳 DeepSeek · 🌏 Asia · 7h ago • Guangdong province is recruiting top computer science students to strengthen China's AI talent pool. • The recruitment effort targets Tsinghua graduates and aims to support local AI companies like DeepSeek and Moonshot. • China views AI talent retention as critical to competitive positioning in AI development. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry I gave Tencent’s WeChat AI agent control for 24 hours: where it excelled – and stumbled SCMP – Tech · 🌏 Asia · 2h ago • Tencent is embedding AI agent Xiaowei into WeChat to enable hands-free automation for over a billion users. • The AI agent integrates with WeChat's existing services including payments, transportation, and bill splitting. • A 24-hour test revealed both capabilities and limitations of the integrated agent. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry Optima tackles AI benchmarking's biggest flaw by letting users test models against their own data The Decoder · 4h ago • Artificial Analysis launched Optima, allowing users to benchmark AI models against their own proprietary data. • The platform measures models on quality, cost, and task completion time beyond standard benchmarks. • Custom benchmarks are particularly valuable for evaluating agent-based applications. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry One in five US workers now delegates tasks to AI instead of colleagues, survey finds The Decoder · 5h ago • Twenty percent of employed US workers now delegate tasks to AI rather than human colleagues, per Epoch AI survey. • Workers typically accept AI output with minimal editing, indicating high trust in outputs. • The shift represents measurable workplace adoption of AI task automation.
